README: The sound sheet: which music, which air and which effect, tied to cues and words, never to seconds. Rules: Topics/InThisTown/SOUND.md. Build: python3 scripts/sound.py build in-this-town-same-face

sections.why: Hook, mysteries and tour: the town as he knew it. Bright and busy.
He asks, and gets a rule and no reason. The tune stops; soft steps and a held note.
The funny failure: he walks up, the golem carries him home. Oom-pah.
Night, a torch, a hole in his own floor. One plucked bass, on tiptoe.
The edge. A pulse that grows for nine seconds, up to the top of the hill.
The colour of the film changes on this cut, and so does the sound: one low note, nothing else.
People! Faces! Hands! The music believes him. It has it exactly as wrong as he does.
The smoke clears. No music at all for 2.7 seconds: only a riser, into the worst line of the film.
They were burning a village. The low note comes back and does not move.
Home again, in daylight, and now he understands it. Slow broken chords.
One of them looks up. Back to the low note, with a heartbeat on top, to the end.

beds.why: He hears them before he sees them.

sfx.why: The town bell opens the film. It rings three times in all: here, when he looks back (10.look), and when he understands (13.known).
The cut in to the one face that is different.
'Except me': the hook lands.
The push in on the black house: heavier than the cuts before it.
An old fire, remembered. Planted here; it comes back at 13.black.
The tilt up to the ridge: wind is the sound of the hill for the whole film.
Scene 3: the tour starts.
The nose wags when it is named.
The camera swings round to the front.
Folded sleeves: cloth is the villagers' sound.
The loaf, pushed across the stall with a nose.
The first HMM bubble. Every bubble in the film pops.
The other one nods: understood.
From below, as big as a house.
Its head turns.
The golem bows.
The poppy. Planted: the same sparkle at 7.flower.
A whole arm, waving. The first hand in the film that does anything.
Nobody waves back: one small drop into the silence, as a head tilts.
It was a good life.
The question.
Scene 5: the elder's porch.
'For a long time': a clock that is not there.
The dark bubble: the same pop, an octave down.
A 'hmm' he has never heard.
Her head turns east, to the hill.
The rule, as a wall.
He looks back at it over his shoulder.
He has decided. A small rise into the next morning.
Four hops up the slope: one landing each.
Right behind him.
Picked up like a plank.
The golem's footfalls, as it is animated.
Carried home.
The poppy again.
Six HMM bubbles, one after another, each a note higher. The times are the scene's.
Scene 8: night.
The boards break on the word.
Three punches at the dirt, as he is animated.
The bed slides back over the hole.
And the hole is gone.
Scene 9: the last night.
The torch that lights the friend.
The folded arms heave. Cloth, and nothing comes out.
They give up and go still.
Scene 10: daylight.
A block of the hillside breaks.
Smoke over the top of the hill.
The town bell, a long way off now. The second of three.
The last few steps.
Up to the top. It ends on the cut where the colour changes.
The music is gone. The floor goes out from under the film.
HA. For the whole film the only bubble has said HMM.
The near smoke opens.
Dozens.
A hollow head.
Scene 12.
Five faces up the steps, and not one the same: five different notes.
Every arm goes up at once. A beat after the word, so the word is heard.
And every torch.
He has it exactly wrong, and the chime believes him.
The arm goes up. The sentence is not finished.
The smoke parts like a curtain.
The only music in 13.clear. It ends on the cut.
They were burning a village. The one boom of the film.
After the line, not on it: the roofs, as the film cuts to the ones who live here.
The ones who live here, running.
Home again, daylight.
The windows remember the fire. The crackle of 2.black, paid back.
The town bell, the third time: they knew.
He folds his arms like theirs.
He glances sideways to check he is doing it right.
Scene 14: back to the fire.
He turns round.
He only looks, for as long as the sentence takes.
He waved. The arm goes up on these two words.
The red sign.
The subscribe line gets the one clean bell note of the film.
His own hand, coming slowly up.
